summary: Learn to adopt GenAI copilots safely, redesign workflows, measure productivity, and build a 12 to 18 month AI adoption playbook. Enrol today.
lede: AI copilot adoption and workflow redesign help non-technical teams turn everyday work into governed, measurable use cases. Designed for middle managers, team leads, and business analysts, the course covers how to prioritize role-based opportunities, map workflows, and set prompt, human-review, and data-handling controls. Participants also build productivity baselines and outcome dashboards to assess changes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate AI adoption inside business functions and need practical workflows, governance evidence, and measurable implementation plans.
prerequisites: Prior experience in a business, operational, analytical, project, or team leadership role is recommended. You should bring one recurring workflow or departmental process for analysis. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, ChatGPT, or any another workplace AI assistant helps but is not essential. Advanced AI engineering, model development, and enterprise platform configuration are introduced conceptually rather than taught as implementation skills.
